title: Uninstalled!
body: It is quite disheartening to observe the apparent greed exhibited by developers in the current app market. The subscription model, priced at $9.99 per week, raises significant concerns, particularly when it becomes evident that a substantial portion of the app's features is locked behind a paywall. This approach not only alienates users but also suggests a prioritization of profit over user experience and satisfaction. As a result, many individuals, including myself, are compelled to reconsider our engagement with such applications, leading to decisions to uninstall and share our experiences on platforms like Reddit. This trend of monetization at the expense of accessibility is troubling and warrants a broader discussion about the ethical implications of app pricing strategies in the digital age.
